recommended_approach: Use a Mantaflow liquid domain driven primarily by the base liquid solver, and only enable Domain-level Fluid Guides when you explicitly intend to steer the flow: the manual notes that simply enabling Guides makes the solver use a more accurate (and more expensive) pressure-guiding algorithm even if no guiding data is baked/attached. If guiding is needed, choose a Velocity Source (Effector vs Domain) and tune the guide grid influence via Weight/Size/Velocity Factor.

guides.enabled: Recommended OFF unless you will use guiding (manual notes added solver cost even with no guiding data).
guides.weight: Controls guiding lag (alpha guiding). Numeric range/default not specified in retrieved doc.
guides.size: Determines vortex size produced by guiding (blur radius/beta guiding). Numeric range/default not specified in retrieved doc.
guides.velocity_factor: Scalar multiplier applied to guiding velocities. Numeric range/default not specified in retrieved doc.
